camera-preview.description: Camera preview windows (camera_show_preview_window): dragging the frameless window and the two commands camera-preview.html invokes.

default.description: Main window, task history window and pop-out file viewer windows: the full app UI, so every app command except the main-window-only ones (main-window.json).

file-viewer.description: Pop-out file viewer windows (window_open_file_viewer): on top of the full app UI in default.json, closing themselves after the renderer's unsaved-edits prompt (getCurrentWindow().onCloseRequested destroys the window).

main-window.description: Main window only, on top of the full app UI in default.json: the commands left out of app-commands because nothing else may call them (local terminals, which run a shell on the user's machine for the chat page, and app updates, which download and install a new version of the app).
